extracted.name: Ham & cheese croissants
extracted.description: Recreate this café breakfast favourite at home. We’ve used gruyère, but any good melting cheese will work. It's perfect to use up a Christmas cheeseboard
ingredient_lines: 50g gruyère thinly sliced or grated, plus extra grated cheese for the tops
wholegrain or Dijon mustard for spreading
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 or if using an air fryer, heat it to 190C. Split the croissants through the middle, being careful not to cut all the way through, and put on a baking sheet. Spread chutney over the bases, then top with the ham and cheese.

Close the croissants and spread a little mustard over the tops. Scatter over the grated cheese and some black pepper, if you like. Bake for 8-10 mins until the cheese has melted. Cool for 1-2 mins, then serve.
